   "source": [
    "# Stochastic Variational Inference for scalability with SVGP"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "afa44f64",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "One of the main criticisms of Gaussian processes is their scalability to large datasets. In this notebook, we illustrate how to use the state-of-the-art Stochastic Variational Gaussian Process (SVGP) (*Hensman, et. al. 2013*) to overcome this problem."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 1,
   "id": "67d30e8a",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-15T09:26:07.381047Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-15T09:26:07.380857Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-15T09:26:12.509480Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-15T09:26:12.508579Z"
    },
    "lines_to_next_cell": 1
   },

    "%matplotlib inline\n",
    "import itertools\n",
    "import time\n",
    "\n",
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "import tensorflow as tf\n",
    "\n",
    "import gpflow\n",
    "from gpflow.ci_utils import reduce_in_tests\n",
    "from gpflow.keras import tf_keras\n",
    "\n",
    "plt.style.use(\"ggplot\")\n",
    "\n",
    "# for reproducibility of this notebook:\n",
    "rng = np.random.RandomState(123)\n",
    "tf.random.set_seed(42)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "e075e650",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Generating data\n",
    "For this notebook example, we generate 10,000 noisy observations from a test function:\n",
    "\\begin{equation}\n",
    "f(x) = \\sin(3\\pi x) + 0.3\\cos(9\\pi x) + \\frac{\\sin(7 \\pi x)}{2}\n",
    "\\end{equation}"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 2,
   "id": "13ea2423",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-15T09:26:12.511661Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-15T09:26:12.511301Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-15T09:26:12.516974Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-15T09:26:12.516249Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "def func(x):\n",
    "    return (\n",
    "        np.sin(x * 3 * 3.14)\n",
    "        + 0.3 * np.cos(x * 9 * 3.14)\n",
    "        + 0.5 * np.sin(x * 7 * 3.14)\n",
    "    )\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "N = 10000  # Number of training observations\n",
    "\n",
    "X = rng.rand(N, 1) * 2 - 1  # X values\n",
    "Y = func(X) + 0.2 * rng.randn(N, 1)  # Noisy Y values\n",
    "data = (X, Y)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "3f34bc31",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "We plot the data along with the noiseless generating function:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 3,
   "id": "5eddbaf7",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-15T09:26:12.518472Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-15T09:26:12.518312Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-15T09:26:12.658652Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-15T09:26:12.657973Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 640x480 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "plt.plot(X, Y, \"x\", alpha=0.2)\n",
    "Xt = np.linspace(-1.1, 1.1, 1000)[:, None]\n",
    "Yt = func(Xt)\n",
    "plt.plot(Xt, Yt, c=\"k\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "d83bc666",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Building the model\n",
    "The main idea behind SVGP is to approximate the true GP posterior with a GP conditioned on a small set of \"inducing\" values. This smaller set can be thought of as summarizing the larger dataset. For this example, we will select a set of 50 inducing locations that are initialized from the training dataset:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 4,
   "id": "0f69a85d",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-15T09:26:12.660702Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-15T09:26:12.660452Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-15T09:26:12.778612Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-15T09:26:12.777902Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stderr",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "2026-10-15 09:26:12.665238: E external/local_xla/xla/stream_executor/cuda/cuda_driver.cc:152] failed call to cuInit: INTERNAL: CUDA error: Failed call to cuInit: UNKNOWN ERROR (303)\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "M = 50  # Number of inducing locations\n",
    "\n",
    "kernel = gpflow.kernels.SquaredExponential()\n",
    "Z = X[\n",
    "    :M, :\n",
    "].copy()  # Initialize inducing locations to the first M inputs in the dataset\n",
    "\n",
    "m = gpflow.models.SVGP(kernel, gpflow.likelihoods.Gaussian(), Z, num_data=N)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "440b6c08",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Likelihood computation: batch vs. minibatch\n",
    "First we showcase the model's performance using the whole dataset to compute the ELBO."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 5,
   "id": "b03dab83",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-15T09:26:12.780596Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-15T09:26:12.780419Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-15T09:26:12.783175Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-15T09:26:12.782579Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "elbo = tf.function(m.elbo)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 6,
   "id": "1b0fe98c",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-15T09:26:12.785099Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-15T09:26:12.784917Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-15T09:26:15.650718Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-15T09:26:15.649937Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "<tf.Tensor: shape=(), dtype=float64, numpy=-17730.676725310346>"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 6,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "# TensorFlow re-traces & compiles a `tf.function`-wrapped method at *every* call if the arguments are numpy arrays instead of tf.Tensors. Hence:\n",
    "tensor_data = tuple(map(tf.convert_to_tensor, data))\n",
    "elbo(tensor_data)  # run it once to trace & compile"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 7,
   "id": "b4f60d55",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-15T09:26:15.652344Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-15T09:26:15.652155Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-15T09:26:21.923986Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-15T09:26:21.923277Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "7.75 ms \u00b1 288 \u03bcs per loop (mean \u00b1 std. dev. of 7 runs, 100 loops each)\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "%%timeit\n",
    "elbo(tensor_data)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "d2d8bf78",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "We can speed up this calculation by using minibatches of the data. For this example, we use minibatches of size 100."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 8,
   "id": "c4d929e3",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-15T09:26:21.926104Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-15T09:26:21.925897Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-15T09:26:21.958255Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-15T09:26:21.957687Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "minibatch_size = 100\n",
    "\n",
    "train_dataset = tf.data.Dataset.from_tensor_slices((X, Y)).repeat().shuffle(N)\n",
    "\n",
    "train_iter = iter(train_dataset.batch(minibatch_size))\n",
    "\n",
    "ground_truth = elbo(tensor_data).numpy()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 9,
   "id": "4f352b26",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-15T09:26:21.960568Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-15T09:26:21.960394Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-15T09:26:22.320313Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-15T09:26:22.319577Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "904 \u03bcs \u00b1 125 \u03bcs per loop (mean \u00b1 std. dev. of 7 runs, 1 loop each)\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "%%timeit\n",
    "elbo(next(train_iter))"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "f05f9447",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "### Stochastical estimation of ELBO\n",
    "The minibatch estimate should be an unbiased estimator of the `ground_truth`. Here we show a histogram of the value from different evaluations, together with its mean and the ground truth. The small difference between the mean of the minibatch estimations and the ground truth shows that the minibatch estimator is working as expected."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 10,
   "id": "fdb29ab8",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-15T09:26:22.322035Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-15T09:26:22.321855Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-15T09:26:22.405393Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-15T09:26:22.404717Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "evals = [\n",
    "    elbo(minibatch).numpy() for minibatch in itertools.islice(train_iter, 100)\n",
    "]"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 11,
   "id": "f176ea4d",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-15T09:26:22.407069Z",

    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "Discrepancy between ground truth and minibatch estimate: -21.802624793072027\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",

       "<Figure size 640x480 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "plt.hist(evals, label=\"Minibatch estimations\")\n",
    "plt.axvline(ground_truth, c=\"k\", label=\"Ground truth\")\n",
    "plt.axvline(np.mean(evals), c=\"g\", ls=\"--\", label=\"Minibatch mean\")\n",
    "plt.legend()\n",
    "plt.title(\"Histogram of ELBO evaluations using minibatches\")\n",
    "print(\n",
    "    \"Discrepancy between ground truth and minibatch estimate:\",\n",
    "    ground_truth - np.mean(evals),\n",
    ")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "622689b7",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "### Minibatches speed up computation\n",
    "The reason for using minibatches is that it decreases the time needed to make an optimization step, because estimating the objective is computationally cheaper with fewer data points. Here we plot the change in time required with the size of the minibatch. We see that smaller minibatches result in a cheaper estimate of the objective."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 12,
   "id": "6f5ac17a",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-15T09:26:22.615508Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-15T09:26:22.615342Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-15T09:26:26.719986Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-15T09:26:26.719179Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "# Evaluate objective for different minibatch sizes\n",
    "minibatch_proportions = np.logspace(-2, 0, 10)\n",
    "times = []\n",
    "objs = []\n",
    "for mbp in minibatch_proportions:\n",
    "    batchsize = int(N * mbp)\n",
    "    train_iter = iter(train_dataset.batch(batchsize))\n",
    "    start_time = time.time()\n",
    "    objs.append(\n",
    "        [elbo(minibatch) for minibatch in itertools.islice(train_iter, 20)]\n",
    "    )\n",
    "    times.append(time.time() - start_time)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 13,
   "id": "a0becb78",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-15T09:26:26.721896Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-15T09:26:26.721716Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-15T09:26:26.981009Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-15T09:26:26.980257Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {

      "text/plain": [

      ]
     },

    "f, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(16, 6))\n",
    "ax1.plot(minibatch_proportions, times, \"x-\")\n",
    "ax1.set_xlabel(\"Minibatch proportion\")\n",
    "ax1.set_ylabel(\"Time taken\")\n",
    "\n",
    "ax2.plot(minibatch_proportions, np.array(objs), \"kx\")\n",
    "ax2.set_xlabel(\"Minibatch proportion\")\n",
    "ax2.set_ylabel(\"ELBO estimates\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "84533d2a",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "### Running stochastic optimization"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "72a0cd24",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "First we create a utility function that plots the model's predictions:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 14,
   "id": "ab570505",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-15T09:26:26.982682Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-15T09:26:26.982505Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-15T09:26:27.264191Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-15T09:26:27.263566Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 1200x400 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "def plot(title=\"\"):\n",
    "    plt.figure(figsize=(12, 4))\n",
    "    plt.title(title)\n",
    "    pX = np.linspace(-1, 1, 100)[:, None]  # Test locations\n",
    "    pY, pYv = m.predict_y(pX)  # Predict Y values at test locations\n",
    "    plt.plot(X, Y, \"x\", label=\"Training points\", alpha=0.2)\n",
    "    (line,) = plt.plot(pX, pY, lw=1.5, label=\"Mean of predictive posterior\")\n",
    "    col = line.get_color()\n",
    "    plt.fill_between(\n",
    "        pX[:, 0],\n",
    "        (pY - 2 * pYv ** 0.5)[:, 0],\n",
    "        (pY + 2 * pYv ** 0.5)[:, 0],\n",
    "        color=col,\n",
    "        alpha=0.6,\n",
    "        lw=1.5,\n",
    "    )\n",
    "    Z = m.inducing_variable.Z.numpy()\n",
    "    plt.plot(Z, np.zeros_like(Z), \"k|\", mew=2, label=\"Inducing locations\")\n",
    "    plt.legend(loc=\"lower right\")\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "plot(title=\"Predictions before training\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "0809aebe",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Now we can train our model. For optimizing the ELBO, we use the Adam Optimizer *(Kingma and Ba 2015)* which is designed for stochastic objective functions. We create a `run_adam` utility function  to perform the optimization."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 15,
   "id": "80539ab8",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-15T09:26:27.266955Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-15T09:26:27.266783Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-15T09:26:27.275590Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-15T09:26:27.274930Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "minibatch_size = 100\n",
    "\n",
    "# We turn off training for inducing point locations\n",
    "gpflow.set_trainable(m.inducing_variable, False)\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def run_adam(model, iterations):\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    Utility function running the Adam optimizer\n",
    "\n",
    "    :param model: GPflow model\n",
    "    :param interations: number of iterations\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    # Create an Adam Optimizer action\n",
    "    logf = []\n",
    "    train_iter = iter(train_dataset.batch(minibatch_size))\n",
    "    training_loss = model.training_loss_closure(train_iter, compile=True)\n",
    "    optimizer = tf_keras.optimizers.Adam()\n",
    "\n",
    "    @tf.function\n",
    "    def optimization_step():\n",
    "        optimizer.minimize(training_loss, model.trainable_variables)\n",
    "\n",
    "    for step in range(iterations):\n",
    "        optimization_step()\n",
    "        if step % 10 == 0:\n",
    "            elbo = -training_loss().numpy()\n",
    "            logf.append(elbo)\n",
    "    return logf"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "715004e5",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Now we run the optimization loop for 20,000 iterations."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 16,
   "id": "3a496fd2",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-15T09:26:27.277508Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-15T09:26:27.277352Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-15T09:26:47.347008Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-15T09:26:47.346229Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
